/orders.post:
from orders_sdk import OrdersSdk
from orders_sdk.models import CreateOrderRequest

sdk = OrdersSdk(
    timeout=10
)

request_body = CreateOrderRequest(
    customer_id="usr-002",
    total=99.5,
    status="pending",
    currency="USD"
)

result = sdk.orders.create_order(request_body=request_body)

print(result)
